---
name: Bug Report
description: Use this template to report a bug in the project.

fields:
  - name: Summary
    description: Briefly describe the bug.
    required: true
  - name: Steps to Reproduce
    description: List the steps required to reproduce the issue.
    required: true
  - name: Expected Behavior
    description: Describe what you expected to happen.
    required: true
  - name: Actual Behavior
    description: Describe what actually happened.
    required: true
  - name: Scope
    description: Indicate the scope of the bug.
    required: false
  - name: Dependencies
    description: List any dependencies related to this bug.
    required: false
  - name: Conflicts
    description: Describe any conflicts with other features.
    required: false
  - name: Additional Context
    description: Add any additional context like screenshots or logs.
    required: false
---
